requirements.risk: Frontend may present forged/malformed or failed session state as authenticated.

scenarios.given: The backend returns an authenticated string user ID
scenarios.when: Read the same-origin session
scenarios.then: Use same-origin credentials and no-store; retain only the string principal ID, never the CSRF token
tests: workspace.test.mjs#session reads only the same-origin authenticated session with no-store

scenarios.given: 401, malformed/missing identity, 500 or network failure
scenarios.when: Read the session
scenarios.then: 401 stays anonymous; every invalid or failed response stays unavailable without leaking server details
tests: workspace.test.mjs#anonymous sessions stay signed out
workspace.test.mjs#malformed identity, server failures and network errors never claim authentication

requirements.risk: The baseline could replace persistent panels, confuse users with invented finance data, or share theme preference across identities.

scenarios.given: An anonymous session in the approved A plus dark-mode shell
scenarios.when: Render the real React workspace to markup
scenarios.then: Keep both named panels, Fancy's labelled separator at28percent, System/Light/Dark controls and separate preference keys
tests: workspace.test.mjs#workspace keeps two named panels and the published accessible splitter
workspace.test.mjs#workspace exposes System, Light and Dark choices without fake finance or provider controls
workspace.test.mjs#theme storage is separate for each authenticated user and the signed-out workspace

scenarios.given: Session availability fails
scenarios.when: Render the workspace
scenarios.then: Show Workspace unavailable and a recovery action with no private diagnostic/token content
tests: workspace.test.mjs#failed session checks show recovery without leaking response details or showing data

requirements.risk: Node test execution could run without reviewed acceptance or silently retain changed/skipped/unmapped coverage.

scenarios.given: Independent reviewed positive and negative Node fixtures
scenarios.when: Parse coverage before importing app/tests
scenarios.then: No alignment errors
tests: alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment accepts independent reviewed positive and negative fixtures

scenarios.given: Skipped tests, empty coverage, weakened source or a new unmapped test
scenarios.when: Parse coverage
scenarios.then: Reject each invalid state with a specific skip/requirements/source-changed/unmapped diagnostic
tests: alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment rejects missing coverage and skipped tests
alignment.test.mjs#frontend alignment rejects weakened tests and unrelated mappings after review

requirements.risk: Browser update tracking could invent an update on errors, expose private responses, share seen cursors, or omit a discoverable updates control.

scenarios.given: A valid public version, the installed release groups and two separate principals
scenarios.when: Check a build and render the update surface
scenarios.then: Use bounded same-origin uncached checks; show the installed release label, build and named What's new action; Fancy selects only unseen groups with separate cosmetic keys
tests: updates.test.mjs#version checks fetch the same-origin uncached build with bounded lifetime and no redirects
updates.test.mjs#release notes describe the installed build and Fancy selects only unseen release groups per account
updates.test.mjs#the update surface always exposes the installed build and a named whats-new button without a false update alert

scenarios.given: Failed transport, non-JSON, 503 or invalid build IDs
scenarios.when: Check deployed version
scenarios.then: Reject with only Build check unavailable so the package does not announce an invented update
tests: updates.test.mjs#failed or malformed version responses reject with a generic message instead of signalling an update

requirements.risk: A constant or inconsistent version could hide backend/frontend changes, include runtime files, or mislabel release notes.

scenarios.given: A fixture with backend, frontend, release notes and an excluded runtime file
scenarios.when: Generate identities across repeated inputs and independent source changes
scenarios.then: Produce stable64hex IDs across repeated builds/newlines/runtime changes, but a different ID for each backend/frontend/notes change
tests: build-info.test.mjs#build identity is stable across repeated builds and checkout newlines but changes with backend frontend or notes

scenarios.given: Empty, duplicate, malformed or non-text release cards
scenarios.when: Generate build metadata
scenarios.then: Refuse each invalid release with Invalid release metadata
tests: build-info.test.mjs#empty duplicate or malformed release metadata stops the build instead of generating a misleading release

requirements.risk: String-only path equality may reject an actual Windows temporary-directory alias or allow cleanup outside the owned fixture.

scenarios.given: Real temporary directories on the supported Windows filesystem, including alternate case for the same parent
scenarios.when: Validate fixture ownership before launching or cleaning browser state
scenarios.then: Actual owned directories and alternate names for the same physical parent pass
tests: browser-profile.test.mjs#browser fixture accepts its actual owned temporary parent
browser-profile.test.mjs#Windows aliases and path casing identify the same physical temporary directory

scenarios.given: Real temporary directories on the supported Windows filesystem, including alternate case for the same parent
scenarios.when: Validate fixture ownership before launching or cleaning browser state
scenarios.then: A different physical parent or directory without the owned fixture prefix is rejected
tests: browser-profile.test.mjs#browser fixture refuses a different physical parent and unowned directory name

requirements.risk: Login UI could send passwords without CSRF, leak credentials/diagnostics, or misrepresent failed logout as success.

scenarios.given: A server CSRF token and successful login/logout responses
scenarios.when: Submit real authentication actions through the client adapters
scenarios.then: Use same-origin no-store nonredirecting CSRF-protected requests, keep credentials out of retained state, and verify logout acknowledgement.
tests: auth.test.mjs#sign-in sends bounded same-origin credentials with the server CSRF token and retains no secrets
auth.test.mjs#sign-out requires CSRF POST and a verified backend response

scenarios.given: Anonymous and authenticated session models
scenarios.when: Render the real workspace
scenarios.then: Expose a labelled username/password form with native autocomplete semantics only while signed out, and Sign out only while authenticated.
tests: auth.test.mjs#anonymous workspace has a labelled password form and authenticated workspace has sign-out

scenarios.given: Invalid credentials, rate limit, identity conflict, server failure or malformed CSRF bootstrap
scenarios.when: Attempt sign-in
scenarios.then: Return only fixed safe failure states; never send a password after invalid CSRF bootstrap or reflect raw server diagnostics.
tests: auth.test.mjs#sign-in errors never expose raw diagnostics and failed CSRF bootstrap sends no password

requirements.risk: Intake forms could coerce unknown/false, overwrite stale facts, send forged authority or reflect private diagnostics.

scenarios.given: Known false, unknown, empty collections and forged extra draft fields
scenarios.when: Build the exact fact payload and human-readable text
scenarios.then: Retain false, force unknown to null, omit identity hints and render No/Unknown/None recorded distinctly
tests: intake.test.mjs#intake preserves known false and explicit unknown without inferring tax status

scenarios.given: A server CSRF token and real optimistic fact/evidence draft
scenarios.when: Send a fact save through the client adapter
scenarios.then: POST exact entity path/body/version with same-origin no-store redirect refusal and bounded signal
tests: intake.test.mjs#fact saves send exact optimistic evidence through protected same-origin requests

scenarios.given: Invalid request, signed-out, denied, conflict, failure or malformed CSRF response
scenarios.when: Attempt a fact save
scenarios.then: Return only fixed safe states without changing draft version/value; malformed CSRF stops before write
tests: intake.test.mjs#intake conflicts denial failures and invalid csrf expose only fixed states

scenarios.given: Malformed records, path injection or failed/non-JSON transport
scenarios.when: Read intake state
scenarios.then: Reject malformed state generically and make no request for a supplied resource path
tests: intake.test.mjs#intake reads reject malformed records and caller supplied resource paths

scenarios.given: A created engagement/entity and paged historical fact
scenarios.when: Create and read history through the adapter
scenarios.then: Retain separate engagement/entity/revision identities and exact bounded history cursor/value
tests: intake.test.mjs#engagement creation and history retain separate entity and revision identities

requirements.risk: Misleading local setup/chat, credential exposure or optimistic fake readiness.

scenarios.given: An unclaimed local install
scenarios.when: Render the admin form and parse setup status
scenarios.then: Show exactly username, new password and confirmation fields, explain the following setup conversation, distinguish true/false setup, and show no setup-code or file-discovery instructions or invented provider connection.
tests: onboarding.test.mjs#first-run adapter and form distinguish local administrator creation from account setup

scenarios.given: Strong matching administrator credentials with no setup code
scenarios.when: Submit administrator creation
scenarios.then: Send only username, password and confirmation in bounded same-origin CSRF requests and retain only the created result.
tests: onboarding.test.mjs#administrator creation uses CSRF and bounded same-origin requests without retaining credentials

scenarios.given: Invalid fields, malformed setup status or server errors
scenarios.when: Attempt local setup
scenarios.then: Reject malformed input without network, map invalid/closed/unavailable states including CSRF denial, and expose no raw diagnostics or obsolete invalid-code result.
tests: onboarding.test.mjs#invalid setup and failed bootstrap cannot claim success or disclose server diagnostics

scenarios.given: A saved setup review with unknown basis and untrusted entity text
scenarios.when: Confirm through the adapter and render review
scenarios.then: Send exact revision/action/answer with CSRF and display explicit unknown/date/escaped names.
tests: onboarding.test.mjs#chat adapter sends only revision action and answer and renders an escaped explicit review

scenarios.given: Unauthorized/stale/failing HTTP and malformed or falsely connected bodies
scenarios.when: Read account setup or submit invalid revision
scenarios.then: Return only fixed denied/conflict/unavailable/invalid states and reject fake provider readiness or role fields.
tests: onboarding.test.mjs#chat errors and malformed or falsely connected responses never become accepted setup state

requirements.risk: A transient partial DevToolsActivePort file incorrectly fails required native browser startup.

scenarios.given: An owned browser connection file written in separate chunks
scenarios.when: The complete loopback port and browser UUID record becomes available
scenarios.then: Return the exact validated port/path only after the final chunk is present.
tests: browser-profile.test.mjs#browser connection readiness waits through partial file writes and rejects unsafe records

scenarios.given: Empty, partially written or malformed browser connection records
scenarios.when: Check readiness before connecting to the owned browser
scenarios.then: Keep waiting for partial records and refuse zero/out-of-range/address ports, foreign URLs and extra lines.
tests: browser-profile.test.mjs#browser connection readiness waits through partial file writes and rejects unsafe records

scenarios.given: An owned real browser file exists but its initial open reports ENOENT EBUSY EPERM or EACCES
scenarios.when: Poll startup readiness before connecting to the owned debugger
scenarios.then: Keep waiting on those transient opens; accept only the exact subsequently readable valid record, refuse unsafe records and propagate unrelated I/O errors.
tests: browser-profile.test.mjs#browser startup tolerates transient file open races but never accepts an unread or unsafe record

requirements.risk: The client could widen identity, fabricate authority readiness or retry an uncertain mutation.

scenarios.given: Synthetic authority responses and captured request options.
scenarios.when: authority reads preserve exact decimal evidence and current server scope
scenarios.then: The exact scoped summary and decimal evidence survive a private bounded same-origin read.
tests: authority.test.mjs#authority reads preserve exact decimal evidence and current server scope

scenarios.given: Synthetic authority responses and captured request options.
scenarios.when: authority rejects foreign scope malformed evidence and unexpected execution readiness
scenarios.then: Foreign entity identity, malformed grants, invented execution readiness and untrusted paths stay unavailable.
tests: authority.test.mjs#authority rejects foreign scope malformed evidence and unexpected execution readiness

scenarios.given: Synthetic authority responses and captured request options.
scenarios.when: authority revocation sends only the reason through fresh csrf and does not invent success
scenarios.then: Revocation sends only the reason with a fresh valid CSRF token and accepts only the exact revoked result.
tests: authority.test.mjs#authority revocation sends only the reason through fresh csrf and does not invent success

scenarios.given: Synthetic authority responses and captured request options.
scenarios.when: authority errors are fixed and uncertain mutation responses require reload
scenarios.then: Server failures become fixed states; uncertain mutation bodies and invalid CSRF never become success.
tests: authority.test.mjs#authority errors are fixed and uncertain mutation responses require reload

scenarios.given: Synthetic authority responses and captured request options.
scenarios.when: authority pagination binds the exact server cursor and rejects invented paths
scenarios.then: Pagination sends the exact valid cursor and never requests an invented path.
tests: authority.test.mjs#authority pagination binds the exact server cursor and rejects invented paths

requirements.risk: Late or uncertain requests can claim false persistence or display a different users preferences.

scenarios.given: A saved private layout response for the current user
scenarios.when: Read through the production layout client
scenarios.then: Accept only a bounded exact valid snapshot from the same-origin current principal
tests: layout.test.mjs#saved layout reads are bounded same-origin and bound to the expected user

scenarios.given: A loaded server layout identity and revision
scenarios.when: Commit a divider gesture
scenarios.then: Use fresh CSRF, scoped identity and expected revision and accept only the exact acknowledged next snapshot
tests: layout.test.mjs#layout writes use fresh CSRF identity and exact revision and verify the acknowledged change

scenarios.given: A gesture whose acknowledgement is lost
scenarios.when: Try another write before reloading the saved server state
scenarios.then: Make only one mutation and preserve the unsaved width with unavailable state until explicit reread
tests: layout.test.mjs#layout gesture state saves once and unknown outcome requires an explicit reread

scenarios.given: Overlapping reads followed by a principal unmount
scenarios.when: Resolve reads out of order and after disposal or return a different principal
scenarios.then: Ignore stale publications and never display the other principals width
tests: layout.test.mjs#stale loads and disposed identities cannot publish another users saved width

scenarios.given: An unresolved mutation followed by an explicit saved-state read
scenarios.when: Attempt another gesture then resolve the old acknowledgement after reread
scenarios.then: Lock overlapping writes and ignore the stale mutation response
tests: layout.test.mjs#a pending commit locks further writes and stale acknowledgements after reload are ignored

requirements.risk: Unbounded or unvalidated agent view documents can inject code, bind foreign data or leak a prior principals catalog.

scenarios.given: The published screen bridge and approved work-view catalog
scenarios.when: Create navigate update and remove a schema-driven work view
scenarios.then: The controlled active view and schema change through actual package tools and the real panel renders a Fancy screen
tests: user-panel.test.mjs#published screen bridge creates navigates updates and removes bounded work views

scenarios.given: An untrusted proposed view document
scenarios.when: Use arbitrary components, unsafe props, foreign-owner hints, duplicate IDs or unbounded structures
scenarios.then: Reject the document before rendering while accepting a registered bounded composition
tests: user-panel.test.mjs#schema validation rejects arbitrary code bindings unsafe props and unbounded documents

scenarios.given: Two independent mounted principals and a private generated view
scenarios.when: Make invalid bridge changes or navigate from the other principal, then dispose the first
scenarios.then: Invalid operations preserve the complete catalog, other users cannot enumerate or select the view, and disposed tools are withdrawn
tests: user-panel.test.mjs#invalid bridge changes preserve the current catalog and never gain another principals views

scenarios.given: A validated view and mutable caller-owned document
scenarios.when: Mutate the input after acceptance and exceed the eight-view catalog bound
scenarios.then: The accepted schema remains unchanged and the rejected ninth view changes no state
tests: user-panel.test.mjs#accepted schema is copied and view quotas and reserved builtins remain enforced
